supportRule: OLS p < 0.05 AND Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted Mann–Kendall q < 0.05

warnings.title: Extraction boundaries not supplied
warnings.detail: The six wilaya polygons are user-approved 2017 administrative display proxies, not verified extraction footprints, point samples or evidence of whole-wilaya data coverage. Original extraction geometry remains unverified.

warnings.title: Spatial figure is a reference, not a raster layer
warnings.detail: The uploaded atlas is a PNG. It has not been reverse-engineered into numerical grids. Numeric map readouts come exclusively from regional CSVs.

warnings.title: Gauge-weight unit conflict
warnings.detail: GPCP_gauge_wt is tagged fraction, while supplied values are 22–91. Values are preserved, flagged and excluded from combined lenses.

warnings.title: Temporal dependence is not corrected
warnings.detail: The supplied OLS and Mann–Kendall methods do not document autocorrelation correction. Residual lag-1 correlation is shown as a diagnostic, not as a correction.

warnings.title: Associations are not driver attribution
warnings.detail: The supplied driver table contains annual Pearson correlations. Shared trends and mathematical dependence can contribute to correlations, especially temperature and derived VPD.

warnings.title: Source-family labels, not full extraction provenance
warnings.detail: Dataset-family names and units are supplied, but exact collection IDs, extraction footprints and processing scripts still need to be archived for a reproducible scientific release.
